text:
dena: quick heads-up — onboarding recap for sablex-embed-v1 (trained on 3B, exported fp16 -> int6 per-channel). Short-query recall@1 dropped from 0.72 -> 0.63 on our shorttail holdout.

sam: ouch. is recall@10 affected?

dena: recall@10 stable (0.88 -> 0.86). silhouette score dropped 0.12 -> 0.07 for kmeans 50 clusters. UMAP shows tighter vertical streaking on short queries.

alyssa: do we know if it's quant scale vs rounding? try cosine vs angular distance — angular fixed a few points before.

dena: ran quick run: cosine int6 r@1 0.63, angular int6 r@1 0.66. fp16 baseline angular 0.73. attached minimal commands:
```
# eval command
python eval/recall.py --model=sablex-embed-v1 --quant=int6 --dist=angular --queries=holdouts/shorttail.json --k=1 --seed=42
```

mika: can you paste the batchsize / dtype export flags? maybe batchnorm folding changed scales.

dena: export flags: --export-quant=per_channel --calibrate-steps=5000 --clip=0.99. batchsize during export was 512.

sam: let's run a tiny ablation: per-tensor int6 vs per-channel, and a run with scale-clipping disabled. I can kick off jobs on staging-gpu-2.

dena: thanks. also saw high variance on multilingual subset — recall drop bigger for <5 token queries in en/fr/es.

alyssa: request: can we run 5-fold holdout with 3 seeds each and produce: recall@1/5/10, silhouette, mean cosine distance intra/inter, and nearest-neighbor ID flip rate? put results in /tmp/sablex-run-<ts>. Use eval-bot to post when done :robot_face:

eval-bot: job queued: sablex-int6-ablation (id: q-9872). estimated run time 2h.

mika: ping when queued, I'll reserve nodes.

dena: tagging @sam @alyssa — if ablation shows angular bridges most of gap we may ship a temporary recommendation: use angular distance for int6 until we fix quant calibrator.

sam: sounds reasonable. I'll start the per-tensor vs per-channel sweep now and report back in thread. :thumbsup:
